title: ID0423379-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S0 170004104]  Charger never recieves start transaction
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Customer have reported a couple of times that the charger doesn't start transaction even if they send it from the backend. Last time it started to work after a couple of days and then also the backend recieved a lot of logs. Can it be a bad connectopn to the backend?
Last time this happend was 2025-05-08 19:30 local time. They also tried to reboot from backend but nothing happend.

additional_info.subject: Sv: ID0423379-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S0 170004104]  Charger never recieves start transaction CRM:00315002613
additional_info.body:
This is the message I got from the customer. I have translated it to English.
Hi again,
Now we have had a similar problem approx. 19.30. The charger does not send to the backend that the vehicle is connected....
The truck that was tested then, seemed to change position in the screen when the vehicle was connected and when the RFID was read but never received a signal to start charging.
I have tried sending the restart command "reboot" from Vourity to the charger in the hope that it would start at 21:13 but has not started yet...

additional_info.body:
Hello guys
so here you can look for the unique message iD to find the response to that StartTransaction message :
be4e17f8-b437-4b26-b2d8-8fb537b0468f
then you will Find 2 entries in the logs:
2025-05-07T17:23:36.690104+00:00 [FW060103G2] sicharge-cp [local0:info] sicharge-cp-backend/7ff38a34a44c[643]: OCPP: Send command: StartTransaction (be4e17f8-b437-4b26-b2d8-8fb537b0468f) - {"connectorId":1,"idTag":"33BDBBF4","meterStart":19898330,"timestamp":"2025-05-07T17:23:36.681Z"}
2025-05-07T17:23:51.694724+00:00 [FW060103G2] sicharge-cp [local0:err] sicharge-cp-backend/7ff38a34a44c[643]: {"stack":"Error:
Timeout for message
be4e17f8-b437-4b26-b2d8-8fb537b0468f - {\"connectorId\":1,\"idTag\":\"33BDBBF4\",\"meterStart\":19898330,\"timestamp\":\"2025-05-07T17:23:36.681Z\"}\n at
onRejectResponse
(/node_modules/@sicharge-cp/ocpp-lib/dist/Connection.js:217:82)\n at Timeout.<anonymous> (/node_modules/@sicharge-cp/ocpp-lib/dist/Connection.js:197:25)\n at listOnTimeout (node:internal/timers:581:17)\n at process.processTimers (node:internal/timers:519:7)"}
So the message from Charger to Backend was send but we got no confirmation from Backend normally its like this
OCPP: Send command: StartTransaction (379afe20-534b-4ef2-bb22-70a1e7994774) - {"connectorId":1,"idTag":"33BDBBF4","meterStart":23278249,"timestamp":"2025-05-21T08:26:05.403Z"}
OCPP: Received result: StartTransaction (16774453-bb44-4c41-b2c7-55583f08cfeb) - {"idTagInfo":{"status":"Accepted"},"
transactionId":9311703
}
so some how we didnt get a response from Backend and without Transaction ID we will not start any session. So question would be why did the Backend not respond.
Thank you.
With best regards,
Semih Sentürk
